description: This file implements the CountryDao interface, providing database access methods for Country entities, specifically a method to list countries filtered by language.

classes.name: CountryDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CountryDao interface, extending generic DAO functionality and providing country-specific data retrieval methods.

methods.name: listByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Country entities filtered by the specified Language, joining description data and ordering by name.
